description: Batch codon optimization for teams and agents: optimize up to 50 protein or cDNA coding sequences in one call with the Logos bio-engine (CAI maximization, GC harmonization, restriction-site avoidance, consensus leaders). Free tier: 100 sequences per caller per day. Overage is $0.50 USDC per 10 sequences ($0.05/sequence) on Base, verified on-chain — pass payment_proof when the batch exceeds the free tier. Research Use Only (RUO); select-agent sequences prohibited.

api_key.description: Optional stable caller identifier for quota tracking (useful behind shared IPs). Self-asserted in v1.

gc_target.description: Target global GC percentage (e.g., 52 for E. coli, 58 for Human). Optional.

payment_proof.description: USDC transaction hash on Base. Required when the batch exceeds the 100/day free tier.

sequences.description: Amino acid sequences (single-letter uppercase) or DNA coding sequences to optimize. Max 50 per call; max 5000 characters each.

name: batch_optimize_codon

text.description: JSON with per-sequence optimization results and quota usage summary.
